purpose: Capture and repair the reproduced USB-only weather-entry SRAM allocation failure; historical long-idle wake failure remains unproven.

baseline.identity_limit: User reports no later flashing. Initial UART banner says a94efc59; banner alone does not prove application identity. No device flash readback was performed.

user_reports: Battery connected; 500mAh, charge voltage limit 4.2V/cell. Motor connected to VIB; no new firmware flashed.

Weather was selected from a home ring when a freeze occurred. Display remained lit, touch and KEY1 had no response. Battery was still connected at that event; it must not be labeled USB-only reproduction.

A historical KEY1 wake failure also occurred after approximately ten-plus idle minutes while USB remained connected, before battery integration. Duration is user recollection, not a measured threshold. No fault-time UART is available.
User subsequently confirmed battery disconnected and USB only for the isolation test. VIB motor remained connected.

serial.raw_log_policy: Raw UART remains in the ignored local artifacts directory; only bounded non-private excerpts and hashes are committed.

initial_capture.observation: Complete new boot, BLE connection and weather reception observed. Startup source was not established; this is not the original freeze scene.

weather_entry_isolation.supply: USB only, battery disconnected per user; VIB motor connected without a Product motor service
weather_entry_isolation.requested_procedure: Enable temporary keep-awake; enter weather from the original home ring, return and re-enter for three repetitions.
weather_entry_isolation.limits: No per-click route instrumentation; operation outcome is user feedback. Snapshots describe this run, not the earlier fault. High-water values do not prove overflow or a leak. An incidental 149.65-second sleep and KEY1/screen-on pair were also recorded; this is not the separate five-minute test.

sleep_isolation.supply: USB only, battery disconnected per user; VIB motor remains connected
sleep_isolation.procedure: Disable temporary keep-awake, return to ordinary watch face, allow natural screen-off; passively capture for at least five minutes before user presses KEY1.
sleep_isolation.user_result: Wake, weather entry/return and touch normal
sleep_isolation.result: bounded sample passed; original fault not reproduced
sleep_isolation.limits: Log-to-log elapsed time does not measure physical key-to-photon latency. Post-feedback diagnostic commands were sent after the next natural screen-off and had no immediate response; UART sleep limitations apply. Five minutes does not establish long-idle reliability.

idle_fifteen_minutes.procedure: USB only; passively observe for at least fifteen minutes after the last UART diagnostic transmission, then request KEY1 and weather entry/return. Initial intent was uninterrupted screen-off, but an actual notification interrupted it; classify the realized sample as mixed idle.
idle_fifteen_minutes.result: KEY1 completed screen-on; user then entered launcher, returned home and selected weather, reproducing the fatal allocation failure below
idle_fifteen_minutes.limits: Host capture was closed/reopened without requesting reset; this is not an uninterrupted UART connection. No claim about actual deep residency or current.

reproduced_fault.supply: USB only, battery disconnected per user; VIB motor remains connected
reproduced_fault.user_sequence: Enter launcher, return to home, select weather from home ring
reproduced_fault.user_observation: Frozen lit display with touch and KEY1 unresponsive; user confirmed scene retained
reproduced_fault.assert_excerpt: Assertion failed at function:lv_draw_unit_draw_letter, line number:633 ,(0)
reproduced_fault.proven: Glyph draw-buffer allocation returned null and triggered LV_ASSERT_MALLOC; Product main then entered fatal handling. SRAM heap was nearly full. This failure exists with battery disconnected.
reproduced_fault.not_proven: Descriptor versus pixel-buffer failure and total-capacity versus fragmentation were not separately measured. Initial battery-connected event and every historical long-idle failure cannot all be equated to this instance.
reproduced_fault.post_fault_queries: wf_pm status, list_thread, free, list_mutex, list_sem and list_event were transmitted after the automatic fatal dump; no response was received.

recovery.method: One primary-agent RTS pulse of 150ms, USB retained, no flash write
recovery.result: Old firmware startup and subsequent phone RTC synchronization captured; this intentional recovery is distinct from the original fault.

fix_candidate.scope: Enable existing locked-SDK private-heap path for Product only. No vendor, SDK lock, UI generation, caching policy or charging changes.
fix_candidate.build_wrapper: Local ignored adapter invokes this checkout's scripts/Build.ps1 with the already registered SDK environment; final command remains scons --board=sf32lb52-lchspi-ulp -j6.
fix_candidate.dry_run: Current scripts/Flash.ps1 checks passed via local path adapter; device not opened for DryRun.
fix_candidate.hardware_result: Three-image write_flash --verify exited 0 and a controlled startup enabled the private heap. USB-only original sequence, notification/weather combinations and post-sleep cached-page/touch regressions are user-confirmed normal; final awake heap snapshots match the pre-sleep snapshot. This accepts the bounded reproduced-OOM repair, not historical long-idle faults or battery/power behavior.

flash.application_behavior_acceptance_scope: Only the USB-only original sequence, cached notification/weather combinations and realized notification/KEY1 sleep-resume sample documented below; not uninterrupted five-minute sleep or battery/motor acceptance.

startup.intentional_reset: RTS pulse 150ms after flashing to capture startup; distinct from the prior fault recovery
startup.limits: The predecessor turn was interrupted; this file has no closed event and no accepted page regression. The continuation reopened passive capture without reset in psram-regression-02.

continuation_capture.result: Passive capture reopened and closed cleanly, without a device operation result or heap snapshot. No regression acceptance is claimed; serial silence alone does not establish a fault.
continuation_capture.next_bounded_experiment: After user confirms USB-only and readiness, reopen capture, repeat menu/home/weather three times and all five pages, then measure both heaps, cached-page combinations and natural sleep/resume.

candidate_page_regression.original_sequence: Temporary keep-awake; menu to home to weather to home, three repetitions, all five weather pages on the third repetition
candidate_page_regression.original_sequence_user_result: All three repetitions and five pages normal
candidate_page_regression.feedback_timing: Feedback arrived after capture 02 closed and before capture 03 reopened, without a requested reset. Navigation outcome is user feedback; it is not an instrumented per-click trace.
candidate_page_regression.cached_notification_and_weather_result: User reports notification list/detail/history followed by all five weather pages normal for two repetitions
candidate_page_regression.natural_sleep_resume_result: User confirms post-KEY1 notification history, all five weather pages, touch and return normal in this continuation, answering the predecessor's specific regression question.
candidate_page_regression.post_sleep_user_feedback_original: 刚才 KEY1 唤醒后，一切正常
candidate_page_regression.diagnostic_attempts: Commands sent at 09:00:20 UTC had no immediate response while the device was asleep; the same awake queries at 09:08:12 UTC returned normally. No final post-sleep snapshot was obtained before the earlier interruption. Continuation capture 04 returned final snapshots at 10:01:36 UTC after the user confirmed USB-only temporary keep-awake, without a requested reset.

before_sleep_snapshot.limits: memheap availability is total free space, not a maximum contiguous block. Peak covers this candidate run; stack percentage is the RT-Thread historical estimate. Deep counters establish software-path activity, not exact residency or current.

candidate_page_regression.sleep_procedure: User disables temporary keep-awake and returns to ordinary watch face. Planned five-minute passive screen-off was interrupted by a notification after 296.236 seconds; classify the realized sample separately, then request KEY1 and reuse cached notification/weather pages.
candidate_page_regression.pm_limit: Counters establish SDK DEEP software-path returns during the sample, not exact hardware residency, uninterrupted sleep or current. Notification and KEY1 screen-on are logged; post-KEY1 cached page reuse and touch are accepted from the subsequent user feedback, not an instrumented per-click trace.

capture.limits: Capture ended normally at its bounded limit after the turn was interrupted. KEY1/screen-on log timing is not physical key-to-photon latency. Post-sleep touch, notification/history and weather-page feedback arrived in the next continuation; it is recorded above separately from this UART capture.

final_continuation_capture.user_ready_feedback: 已常亮, in response to the request to keep USB-only with battery disconnected

snapshot.limits: This is a later continuation snapshot, not an immediate post-KEY1 measurement. Available memheap bytes are total free space, not largest contiguous allocation; main stack is a historical estimate. BLE status is a point-in-time snapshot, not continuous connection acceptance.

final_continuation_capture.close_reason: Requested stop after complete final snapshot; COM5 released
final_continuation_capture.limits: No continuous UART exists between captures 03 and 04. No flash or reset was requested in this continuation; acceptance is limited to observed windows and user operations, not all intervening idle time.

source_inspection.weather: No confirmed recursive weather/RTC lock, wait for BLE response, or unbounded creation loop was found. Weather creation and refresh retain large nested stack frames and allocate many LVGL objects. Fault-time evidence above proves a glyph draw-buffer allocation assertion; it does not prove stack overflow.
source_inspection.retained_views: notification_view.c:187-223 caches list and detail screens until destroy (:244-250); apps.c:765 excludes the launcher from normal navigation collection. Reminder contents may coexist with weather. These are reachable additional allocations, not measured OOM evidence.
source_inspection.lvgl_heap: The fault-capture baseline sets LV_USE_RTTHREAD_MALLOC and BSP_USING_PSRAM but does not set LV_RTTHREAD_USE_PSRAM_PRIVATE_HEAP. external/lvgl_v9/src/stdlib/rtthread/lv_mem_core_rtthread.c:27-32,98,157 therefore selects ordinary rt_malloc from SRAM. This baseline log is a configuration choice, not a PSRAM initialization failure; the later candidate changes the allocator configuration as recorded above.
source_inspection.candidate_allocator: Locked-SDK private allocations use the registered lv_psram memheap. Allocation failure falls back to rt_malloc and logs only the first fallback; private-pointer realloc does not fall back across heaps. list_memheap reports pool_size, max_used_size and available_size, not the largest contiguous free block. Source inspection does not establish capacity acceptance.
source_inspection.candidate_deep_retention: Default DEEP reaches the board PSRAM low-power entry/exit APIs with BSP power parameter false. The HAL distinguishes low-power refresh/half-sleep from deep power-down; no active DPD or heap clearing was found on the scoped path. The bounded same-firmware cached-page/touch regression is now user-confirmed normal with DEEP software-path counters and final heap snapshots; this is not a retention guarantee for every sleep mode or duration.
source_inspection.key: A later valid BUTTON_PRESSED still posts KEY while waiting_for_wake even if suppress_wake_click remains set. No confirmed permanent suppression was found. SDK soft timer or UI consumer blockage remains a hypothesis.
source_inspection.uart_limit: UART AON wake is not enabled; serial silence while asleep alone is not evidence of a freeze.
source_inspection.charger: aw32001.c:390-403 enables charging before requesting 4215mV and does not explicitly set charge current. This is an unresolved charging constraint, not a demonstrated freeze cause.
source_inspection.pm_mode_correction: Default DEEP resume calls BSP_Power_Up(false) at middleware/system/bf0_pm.c:1137. The board's true branch is reached at startup/standby; do not assume every ordinary DEEP resume executes charger configuration. HCPU HAL_GetTick uses AON GTIMER rather than an interrupt-driven RT tick.

remaining: Historical long-idle fault cause and uninterrupted fifteen-minute screen-off not established
No battery-alone supply, simultaneous USB/battery charging, motor pulse, voltage/current waveform or battery-life acceptance
No global OOM recovery or unlimited stability/capacity claim
